entries.title: Fourier restriction entropy increment
entries.statement: For Boolean f on a uniform cube with base-2 spectral entropy H(f)=sum_S hat(f)(S)^2 log_2(1/hat(f)(S)^2), define Delta_i(f)=H(f)-(H(f|x_i=+1)+H(f|x_i=-1))/2. Total influence is I(f)=sum_S |S|hat(f)(S)^2 and coordinate influence I_i(f)=sum_{S containing i}hat(f)(S)^2. Zero entropy terms vanish.
entries.domain: probability theory; analysis of Boolean functions

entries.title: Draft exact entropy ledger for a Boolean restriction
entries.statement: DRAFT derivation, independent review pending. For g=f|i=+1, h=f|i=-1, coefficients u_T,v_T, r_T=(u_T^2+v_T^2)/2 and q_T=(u_T-v_T)^2/[2(u_T^2+v_T^2)], Delta_i(f)=JS(u^2,v^2)+sum_T r_T b(q_T)>=0. Here b is binary entropy and JS=H(r)-(H(u^2)+H(v^2))/2. Zero r terms vanish. Also I(f)=(I(g)+I(h))/2+I_i(f). The identity is established territory, including arXiv:2606.00246v2 Eq.32.

entries.title: Failed strengthening: charge every restriction by its influence
entries.statement: The proposed strengthening would demand one finite C with Delta_i(f)<=C I_i(f) for every Boolean f on every finite uniform cube and every coordinate i. The draft bent-splice argument refutes this strengthening, and also refutes choosing the least influential relevant coordinate without an additional argument. It does not refute FEI or a condition requiring just some good coordinate.
assumptions: every coordinate, not an existential choice

entries.title: Draft bent splice obstruction to minimum-influence entropy induction
entries.statement: DRAFT author-derived special case, independent review pending. Let m>=4 be even, N=2^m, g:{0,1}^m->{-1,1} have |hat(g)(T)|=1/sqrt(N) for all T, and a be any vertex. Set h=g-2g(a)1_{z=a}, F(z,+1)=g(z), F(z,-1)=h(z). Then I_y(F)=1/N; each other influence is 1/2 plus or minus 1/N, so y is the unique minimum-influence coordinate. Delta_y(F)/I_y(F)>=log_2(N-2sqrt(N)+2), unbounded with m. Nevertheless H(F)<=3 I(F). Spectral entropies and the selector ratio depend only on m. This is a proof-method obstruction, not a general FEI solution or counterexample.
assumptions: exactly one flipped vertex on one selector branch

entries.title: Unproved good-coordinate principle sufficient for FEI
entries.statement: UNPROVED selection principle: there is a finite universal C such that every nonconstant Boolean f on a uniform cube has some relevant coordinate i satisfying Delta_i(f)<=C I_i(f). If true, the exact influence decomposition and induction on dimension give H(f)<=C I(f). The bent-splice obstruction does not decide this existential principle. This sufficient route is also stated in arXiv:2606.00246v2 Eq.21.
assumptions: C independent of f and dimension

entries.title: Draft proof guard for Fourier entropy induction
entries.statement: Before using a restriction-entropy induction, distinguish a proved charge for the chosen split from a bound merely asserted for all splits or for the minimum-influence split. A bent base with a single-vertex selector splice has minimum-coordinate Delta/I growing with dimension while itself satisfying FEI. A valid class-specific charge or an explicitly unresolved selection gap should remain unaffected. Supporting local hook proposal and measurements are in the w507 review packet.
assumptions: applicable when a proof attempts restriction-entropy induction

relations.rationale: The identity uses the defined entropy increment and influences.
The failed strengthening is an inequality for that increment.
The lower bound diverges for genuine Boolean functions and for their unique minimum-influence coordinate.
Nonnegative JS and binary conditional entropy give the exact lower bound.
The existential principle charges the same increment.
This exact family supports the fire case; it refutes the strengthened route, not FEI.
It is an unproved sufficient route to the exact FEI target, not a solution.
The older attempt rules out forgetting Booleanity; this obstruction retains Booleanity but rules out an unjustified stronger local charge.
